dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT
    s.rawId AS id,
    CASE WHEN s.rawId IS NOT NULL THEN '/drilldown/node?sourceId=Model%2F' || replace(replace(s.rawId, '/', '%2F'), ':', '%3A') || '&__configId={{configId}}' END AS url,
    m.name,
    m.author,
    m.inputPrice,
    m.outputPrice,
    m.cacheReadPrice,
    m.context_length AS contextLength,
    m."top_provider.max_completion_tokens" AS maxCompletionTokens,
    m.inputModalities,
    m.outputModalities,
    m."benchmarks.artificial_analysis.intelligence_index" AS intelligenceIndex,
    m."benchmarks.artificial_analysis.coding_index" AS codingIndex,
    m."benchmarks.artificial_analysis.agentic_index" AS agenticIndex,
    m.knowledge_cutoff AS knowledgeCutoff,
    m.created,
    m.expiration_date AS expirationDate
FROM Models m
JOIN Selected s ON m.id = s.rawId
ORDER BY m.name

config.title: Benchmarks Vs Price
config.description: Higher is better on every axis. Affordability scores price per 1M tokens on a log scale, from 100 at $0.01 or less to 0 at $1,000 or more.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT
    s.sourceId AS id,
    m.name,
    m."benchmarks.artificial_analysis.intelligence_index" AS intelligenceIndex,
    m."benchmarks.artificial_analysis.coding_index" AS codingIndex,
    m."benchmarks.artificial_analysis.agentic_index" AS agenticIndex,
    m.inputAffordability,
    m.outputAffordability,
    m.cacheReadAffordability
FROM Models m
JOIN Selected s ON m.id = s.rawId
ORDER BY m.name

WITH by_slug AS (
    SELECT
        canonical_slug,
        sourceId,
        name
    FROM Selected
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY canonical_slug ORDER BY length(sourceId), sourceId) = 1
)
SELECT
    s.name,
    b.benchmark,
    b.score
FROM Benchmarks b
JOIN by_slug s ON b.model = s.canonical_slug
WHERE b.source = 'artificial-analysis'
ORDER BY b.benchmark, s.name

config.title: Design Arena Elo
config.description: Elo rating by design category. Higher is better.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH by_slug AS (
    SELECT
        canonical_slug,
        sourceId,
        name
    FROM Selected
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY canonical_slug ORDER BY length(sourceId), sourceId) = 1
)
SELECT
    s.name,
    b.benchmark,
    b.score
FROM Benchmarks b
JOIN by_slug s ON b.model = s.canonical_slug
WHERE b.source = 'design-arena' AND b.metric = 'elo'
ORDER BY b.benchmark, s.name

config.title: Session Cost By Harness
config.description: Median cost of one 10–49 turn coding-agent session, by model and harness.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH by_slug AS (
    SELECT
        permaslug,
        sourceId,
        name
    FROM Selected
    -- Datasets key models by permaslug; a :batch model shares its base's, so keep one
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY permaslug ORDER BY length(sourceId), sourceId) = 1
)
SELECT
    s.name,
    c.app_name AS harness,
    c.median_session_cost_usd AS cost
FROM SessionCost c
JOIN by_slug s ON c.model_permaslug = s.permaslug
WHERE c.turn_range = '10-49-turns'
ORDER BY s.name, c.app_name

config.title: OpenRouter Evals
config.description: Results from OpenRouter's own evals. The metric differs by benchmark, so scores aren't comparable across rows.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH by_slug AS (
    SELECT
        canonical_slug,
        sourceId,
        rawId,
        name
    FROM Selected
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY canonical_slug ORDER BY length(sourceId), sourceId) = 1
)
SELECT
    s.rawId AS id,
    CASE WHEN s.rawId IS NOT NULL THEN '/drilldown/node?sourceId=Model%2F' || replace(replace(s.rawId, '/', '%2F'), ':', '%3A') || '&__configId={{configId}}' END AS url,
    s.name,
    b.benchmark,
    b.metric,
    b.score,
    b.tasks,
    b.avgCostPerTask,
    b.avgDurationMs
FROM Benchmarks b
JOIN by_slug s ON b.model = s.canonical_slug
WHERE b.source = 'openrouter'
ORDER BY b.score DESC
